usage: cox route edit [-h] [--title TITLE] [--body BODY] [--body-file BODY_FILE] [--repo REPO]
                      [--surfaces SURFACES] [--state STATE] [--dry-run] [--profile PROFILE]
                      id

positional arguments:
  id                    a queued intake, an initiative or a task ticket

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE
  --body BODY
  --body-file BODY_FILE
  --repo REPO
  --surfaces SURFACES   task ticket only: comma-separated paths that replace the list
  --state STATE         task ticket only: ready, approved, done or dropped; never backward
  --dry-run             print the diff and write nothing
  --profile PROFILE
